memo_delta.stage_one_comment: Nu reported Q3 revenue below the frozen forecast bar, while diluted earnings per share exceeded its bar. The revenue-miss prediction was right and the EPS-miss prediction was wrong. These are two related forecasts from the same company quarter, not two independent tests of investment skill. Neither the larger bullish nor the larger numeric bearish earnings threshold was reached. The original Avoid remains a provisional no-entry stance while the Group valuation and credit-quality tests are unresolved; it is not a short recommendation or a new valuation at today’s unknown price. No updated model, numeric conviction or investment return is supported by this review. Before the scheduled 30 November check, obtain comparable delinquency, credit-cost and allowance measures, a properly scoped Group required return, and matched stock and benchmark prices. Keep the original forecasts and memo unchanged, and preserve the distinction between a mixed earnings result and a validated investment decision.
